options.content:
### Sundays For the Boys
The only league shown here. **Detailed game / trade / draft data: 2023–present** (the Sleeper era). **Champions & toilet bowls go back to 2019**; season standings to 2020. Records that say "ever" mean 2023-present unless noted.

spec.rawSql: SELECT manager AS "Manager", season AS "Season", wins AS "W", losses AS "L" FROM v_season_standings WHERE league_group = 'Sundays For the Boys' ORDER BY wins DESC, losses ASC LIMIT 10

spec.description: Best regular-season records, 2020-present. Sleeper era (2023+) is counted from head-to-head results, so median-scoring years like 2024 are not double-counted.
spec.title: Most wins in a season

spec.rawSql: SELECT manager AS "Manager", season AS "Season", losses AS "L", wins AS "W" FROM v_season_standings WHERE league_group = 'Sundays For the Boys' ORDER BY losses DESC, wins ASC LIMIT 10

spec.description: Worst regular-season records, 2020-present. Sleeper era (2023+) counted from head-to-head results.
spec.title: Most losses in a season

spec.rawSql: SELECT name AS "Manager", SUM((name = champion)::int) AS "Titles", string_agg(CASE WHEN name = champion THEN season::text END, ', ' ORDER BY season) AS "Title years", SUM((name = champion OR name = runner_up)::int) AS "Final appearances" FROM history_seasons, LATERAL (VALUES (champion), (runner_up)) v(name) WHERE league_group = 'Sundays For the Boys' AND name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY name HAVING SUM((name = champion OR name = runner_up)::int) > 0 ORDER BY 2 DESC, 4 DESC

spec.description: Championships won (with the years) and total finals appearances (champion or runner-up), 2019-present.
spec.title: Championship pedigree

spec.rawSql: SELECT toilet_bowl AS "Manager", COUNT(*) AS "Toilet bowls", string_agg(season::text, ', ' ORDER BY season) AS "Seasons" FROM history_seasons WHERE league_group = 'Sundays For the Boys' AND toilet_bowl IS NOT NULL GROUP BY toilet_bowl ORDER BY 2 DESC

spec.description: Dead-last finishes (toilet bowls lost) and the years, 2019-present.
spec.title: Toilet Bowl Hall of Shame

spec.rawSql: SELECT manager AS "Winner", opponent AS "Loser", points_for || ' - ' || points_against AS "Score", ROUND(margin, 2) AS "Margin", season AS "Season", week AS "Week" FROM v_matchup_results WHERE league_group = 'Sundays For the Boys' AND margin > 0 ORDER BY margin DESC LIMIT 5

spec.description: Five largest margins of victory, 2023-present.
spec.title: Top 5 biggest beatdowns

spec.rawSql: SELECT manager AS "Winner", opponent AS "Loser", points_for || ' - ' || points_against AS "Score", ROUND(margin, 2) AS "Margin", season AS "Season", week AS "Week" FROM v_matchup_results WHERE league_group = 'Sundays For the Boys' AND margin > 0 ORDER BY margin ASC LIMIT 5

spec.description: Five smallest winning margins, 2023-present. The ultimate nail-biters.
spec.title: Top 5 closest wins

spec.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(m.alias, m.display_name) AS "Manager", ROUND(tw.points, 2) AS "Points", tw.season AS "Season", tw.week AS "Week" FROM team_week tw JOIN seasons s ON s.league_id = tw.league_id LEFT JOIN managers m ON m.user_id = tw.user_id WHERE s.league_group = 'Sundays For the Boys' AND tw.points IS NOT NULL AND tw.matchup_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY tw.points DESC LIMIT 5

spec.description: The five highest weekly scores any manager has posted, 2023-present.
spec.title: Top 5 highest-scoring weeks

spec.rawSql: WITH wk AS (SELECT tw.season, tw.week, COALESCE(m.alias, m.display_name) AS manager, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY tw.league_id, tw.season, tw.week ORDER BY tw.points DESC) AS rk FROM team_week tw JOIN seasons s ON s.league_id = tw.league_id LEFT JOIN managers m ON m.user_id = tw.user_id WHERE s.league_group = 'Sundays For the Boys' AND tw.points IS NOT NULL AND tw.matchup_id IS NOT NULL) SELECT manager AS "Manager", COUNT(*) AS "Top weeks" FROM wk WHERE rk = 1 GROUP BY manager ORDER BY 2 DESC

spec.description: How many weeks each manager posted the single highest score in the league, 2023-present.
spec.title: Weekly high-score crowns

spec.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(m.alias, m.display_name) AS "Manager", ROUND(tw.points, 2) AS "Points", tw.season AS "Season", tw.week AS "Week" FROM team_week tw JOIN seasons s ON s.league_id = tw.league_id LEFT JOIN managers m ON m.user_id = tw.user_id WHERE s.league_group = 'Sundays For the Boys' AND tw.points IS NOT NULL AND tw.matchup_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY tw.points ASC LIMIT 5

spec.description: The five lowest weekly scores any manager has posted, 2023-present.
spec.title: Top 5 lowest-scoring weeks

spec.rawSql: SELECT manager AS "Manager", SUM(trades) AS "Trades" FROM v_transactions_summary WHERE league_group = 'Sundays For the Boys' GROUP BY manager ORDER BY 2 DESC

spec.description: Completed trades each manager was a party to, 2023-present. Top = most active trader, bottom = fewest.
spec.title: Trades made (all-time)

spec.rawSql: SELECT manager AS "Manager", SUM(waiver_claims + free_agent_adds) AS "Adds" FROM v_transactions_summary WHERE league_group = 'Sundays For the Boys' GROUP BY manager ORDER BY 2 DESC

spec.description: Successful waiver claims plus free-agent adds per manager, 2023-present. The waiver-wire grinders.
spec.title: Waiver + free-agent adds

spec.rawSql: SELECT manager AS "Manager", SUM(faab_spent) AS "FAAB spent" FROM v_transactions_summary WHERE league_group = 'Sundays For the Boys' GROUP BY manager ORDER BY 2 DESC

spec.description: Total free-agent auction budget ($) spent on winning waiver claims, 2023-present.
spec.title: Total FAAB spent

spec.rawSql: SELECT manager AS "Manager", ROUND(SUM(faab_spent)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(waiver_claims), 0), 1) AS "Avg $ per claim" FROM v_transactions_summary WHERE league_group = 'Sundays For the Boys' GROUP BY manager HAVING SUM(waiver_claims) > 0 ORDER BY 2 DESC

spec.description: Average $ spent per successful waiver claim (who pays up per pickup vs. who bargain-hunts), 2023-present.
spec.title: Avg FAAB per winning claim

spec.rawSql: SELECT t.season AS "Season", t.week AS "Week", count(DISTINCT tm.player_id) AS "Players", string_agg(DISTINCT COALESCE(m.alias, m.display_name), ', ') AS "Parties" FROM transactions t JOIN seasons s ON s.league_id = t.league_id JOIN transaction_moves tm ON tm.transaction_id = t.transaction_id LEFT JOIN season_teams st ON st.league_id = t.league_id AND st.roster_id = tm.roster_id LEFT JOIN managers m ON m.user_id = st.user_id WHERE s.league_group = 'Sundays For the Boys' AND t.type = 'trade' AND t.status = 'complete' GROUP BY t.transaction_id, t.season, t.week ORDER BY count(DISTINCT tm.player_id) DESC LIMIT 5

spec.description: The five trades that moved the most players, 2023-present.
spec.title: Biggest trades (by players involved)

spec.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(m.alias, m.display_name) AS "Manager", t.season AS "Season", t.week AS "Week", count(*) AS "Adds" FROM transactions t JOIN seasons s ON s.league_id = t.league_id JOIN transaction_moves tm ON tm.transaction_id = t.transaction_id LEFT JOIN season_teams st ON st.league_id = t.league_id AND st.roster_id = tm.roster_id LEFT JOIN managers m ON m.user_id = st.user_id WHERE s.league_group = 'Sundays For the Boys' AND t.type IN ('waiver', 'free_agent') AND t.status = 'complete' AND tm.action = 'add' GROUP BY m.user_id, COALESCE(m.alias, m.display_name), t.season, t.week ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 5

spec.description: Most players a manager added (waiver + free agent) in a single week, 2023-present. The panic-button award.
spec.title: Busiest roster weeks (most adds)

spec.rawSql: SELECT DISTINCT manager AS "Manager", full_name AS "Player", position AS "Pos", times_drafted_by_mgr AS "Times drafted" FROM v_draft_tendencies WHERE league_group = 'Sundays For the Boys' AND times_drafted_by_mgr > 1 ORDER BY times_drafted_by_mgr DESC, manager LIMIT 10

spec.description: Players a manager drafted in more than one season — auction loyalty, 2023-present.
spec.title: Draft loyalty (same player, multiple years)

spec.rawSql: SELECT manager AS "Manager", SUM(amount) FILTER (WHERE position='QB') AS "QB", SUM(amount) FILTER (WHERE position='RB') AS "RB", SUM(amount) FILTER (WHERE position='WR') AS "WR", SUM(amount) FILTER (WHERE position='TE') AS "TE" FROM v_draft_tendencies WHERE league_group = 'Sundays For the Boys' GROUP BY manager ORDER BY manager

spec.description: How each manager splits auction $ across positions, 2023-present. Bars normalized to 100% of budget.
spec.title: Auction budget by position

spec.rawSql: SELECT manager AS "Manager", count(*) FILTER (WHERE position='QB') AS "QB", count(*) FILTER (WHERE position='RB') AS "RB", count(*) FILTER (WHERE position='WR') AS "WR", count(*) FILTER (WHERE position='TE') AS "TE", count(*) AS "Total" FROM v_draft_tendencies WHERE league_group = 'Sundays For the Boys' GROUP BY manager ORDER BY manager

spec.description: Count of each position drafted per manager, 2023-present.
spec.title: Players drafted by position

spec.rawSql: SELECT manager AS "Manager", ROUND(AVG(amount) FILTER (WHERE position='QB'),1) AS "Avg $ / QB", ROUND(AVG(amount) FILTER (WHERE position='TE'),1) AS "Avg $ / TE" FROM v_draft_tendencies WHERE league_group = 'Sundays For the Boys' GROUP BY manager ORDER BY "Avg $ / QB" DESC NULLS LAST

spec.description: Average auction $ spent per QB and per TE — who overpays at the thin positions, 2023-present.
spec.title: Positional reaches (avg $ on QB & TE)

spec.rawSql: SELECT manager AS "Manager", ROUND(SUM(amount*pick_no)::numeric/NULLIF(SUM(amount),0),1) AS "Avg pick of $ spent" FROM v_draft_tendencies WHERE league_group = 'Sundays For the Boys' GROUP BY manager ORDER BY 2 ASC

spec.description: Dollar-weighted average overall pick number. Lower = blows the budget early on studs; higher = hangs back for value. 2023-present.
spec.title: Auction pace — when the money goes

spec.rawSql: SELECT manager AS "Manager", MAX(CASE WHEN opponent='Bubbles' THEN wins||'-'||losses END) AS "Bubbles", MAX(CASE WHEN opponent='Charb' THEN wins||'-'||losses END) AS "Charb", MAX(CASE WHEN opponent='Connor' THEN wins||'-'||losses END) AS "Connor", MAX(CASE WHEN opponent='Jahn' THEN wins||'-'||losses END) AS "Jahn", MAX(CASE WHEN opponent='Joel' THEN wins||'-'||losses END) AS "Joel", MAX(CASE WHEN opponent='Lanz' THEN wins||'-'||losses END) AS "Lanz", MAX(CASE WHEN opponent='Pate' THEN wins||'-'||losses END) AS "Pate", MAX(CASE WHEN opponent='Skeetdawg' THEN wins||'-'||losses END) AS "Skeetdawg", MAX(CASE WHEN opponent='T1' THEN wins||'-'||losses END) AS "T1", MAX(CASE WHEN opponent='T2' THEN wins||'-'||losses END) AS "T2", MAX(CASE WHEN opponent='Will' THEN wins||'-'||losses END) AS "Will", MAX(CASE WHEN opponent='shades' THEN wins||'-'||losses END) AS "shades" FROM v_h2h WHERE league_group = 'Sundays For the Boys' GROUP BY manager ORDER BY manager

spec.description: Each row is a manager; each cell is their all-time record vs that opponent (wins-losses), 2023-present. Read across your row to see how you fare against each rival.
spec.title: Who Owns Who — all-time head-to-head (W-L)

spec.rawSql: SELECT manager AS "Owner", opponent AS "Victim", wins||'-'||losses AS "Record", games AS "Games", ROUND(avg_margin,1) AS "Avg margin" FROM v_h2h WHERE league_group = 'Sundays For the Boys' AND games >= 3 ORDER BY (wins-losses) DESC, games DESC LIMIT 8

spec.description: Most lopsided head-to-head records, minimum 3 meetings, 2023-present.
spec.title: Who owns who the most (min 3 games)

spec.rawSql: SELECT least(manager,opponent) AS "Manager A", greatest(manager,opponent) AS "Manager B", MAX(games) AS "Times played" FROM v_h2h WHERE league_group = 'Sundays For the Boys' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 8

spec.description: Pairs who have faced each other the most, 2023-present.
spec.title: Most-played rivalries

spec.rawSql: SELECT least(manager,opponent) AS "Manager A", greatest(manager,opponent) AS "Manager B", count(*) AS "Games", ROUND(avg(abs(margin)),1) AS "Avg margin" FROM v_matchup_results WHERE league_group = 'Sundays For the Boys' GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*) >= 3 ORDER BY 4 ASC LIMIT 8

spec.description: Pairs with the smallest average margin — the true coin-flips, min 3 games, 2023-present.
spec.title: Coin-flip rivalries (closest)

spec.rawSql: SELECT least(manager,opponent) AS "Manager A", greatest(manager,opponent) AS "Manager B", count(*) AS "Games", ROUND(stddev_samp(margin),1) AS "Margin swing" FROM v_matchup_results WHERE league_group = 'Sundays For the Boys' GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*) >= 3 ORDER BY 4 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 8

spec.description: Pairs with the highest score-margin variance — wild swings game to game, min 3 games, 2023-present.
spec.title: Most volatile matchups

spec.rawSql: SELECT manager AS "Manager", ROUND(100.0*SUM(points_for)/NULLIF(SUM(potential_points),0),1) AS "Efficiency %" FROM v_manager_season WHERE league_group = 'Sundays For the Boys' AND potential_points > 0 GROUP BY manager ORDER BY 2 DESC

spec.description: Points scored as a share of best-possible lineup points, all-time. Higher = better lineup-setter. 2023-present.
spec.title: Coaching efficiency — all-time

spec.rawSql: SELECT manager AS "Manager", MAX(ROUND(100*coaching_efficiency,1)) FILTER (WHERE season=2023) AS "2023", MAX(ROUND(100*coaching_efficiency,1)) FILTER (WHERE season=2024) AS "2024", MAX(ROUND(100*coaching_efficiency,1)) FILTER (WHERE season=2025) AS "2025", ROUND(100.0*SUM(points_for)/NULLIF(SUM(potential_points),0),1) AS "All-time" FROM v_manager_season WHERE league_group = 'Sundays For the Boys' AND potential_points > 0 GROUP BY manager ORDER BY "All-time" DESC

spec.description: Actual / optimal points per season and all-time (%). 2023-present.
spec.title: Coaching efficiency by season

spec.rawSql: WITH pw AS (SELECT pw.season, pw.week, pw.roster_id, COALESCE(m.alias,m.display_name) AS manager, SUM(pw.points) FILTER (WHERE pw.is_starter) AS starters, SUM(pw.points) FILTER (WHERE NOT pw.is_starter) AS bench FROM player_week pw JOIN seasons s ON s.league_id=pw.league_id LEFT JOIN managers m ON m.user_id=pw.user_id WHERE s.league_group = 'Sundays For the Boys' GROUP BY 1,2,3,4) SELECT manager AS "Manager", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE bench>starters) AS "Weeks bench outscored starters" FROM pw GROUP BY manager HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE bench>starters) > 0 ORDER BY 2 DESC

spec.description: Weeks a manager's bench outscored their entire starting lineup, 2023-present. Only managers it happened to are shown.
spec.title: Should've Left the Bench Alone

spec.rawSql: WITH ap AS (SELECT user_id, manager, SUM(allplay_wins) aw, SUM(allplay_losses) al, SUM(allplay_ties) att FROM v_luck WHERE league_group = 'Sundays For the Boys' GROUP BY user_id, manager), hh AS (SELECT user_id, SUM(wins) w, SUM(losses) l, SUM(ties) t FROM v_season_standings WHERE league_group = 'Sundays For the Boys' AND source='sleeper' GROUP BY user_id) SELECT ap.manager AS "Manager", ROUND(100.0*hh.w/NULLIF(hh.w+hh.l+hh.t,0) - 100.0*ap.aw/NULLIF(ap.aw+ap.al+ap.att,0),1) AS "Luck index" FROM ap JOIN hh ON hh.user_id=ap.user_id ORDER BY 2 DESC

spec.description: How much better (+) or worse (-) a manager's real win % is than their all-play win % (if they played everyone every week). Positive = lucky, negative = unlucky. 2023-present.
spec.title: Luck index (actual vs. all-play)

spec.rawSql: WITH g AS (SELECT user_id, manager, result, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY season,week) - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id, result ORDER BY season,week) AS grp FROM v_matchup_results WHERE league_group = 'Sundays For the Boys'), streaks AS (SELECT user_id, manager, result, count(*) len FROM g GROUP BY user_id, manager, result, grp) SELECT manager AS "Manager", COALESCE(MAX(len) FILTER (WHERE result='W'),0) AS "Longest win streak", COALESCE(MAX(len) FILTER (WHERE result='L'),0) AS "Longest losing streak" FROM streaks GROUP BY manager ORDER BY "Longest win streak" DESC

spec.description: Longest consecutive win and loss runs, across regular season and playoffs, 2023-present.
spec.title: Longest win & losing streaks
